findings.body: This required test was neither added nor changed. The existing file only checks invalid chart types, sort directions, and unknown request fields; it does not cover the newly added `plants_revoked` pin status (or any new plant wire shape). The Swagger test provides broader API-document coverage, but the task explicitly requires a pin-schema test that would fail if this pin-specific contract regressed.
findings.title: Not done: backend/src/pins/pins.schemas.test.ts

findings.body: The schema now accepts `AskRequest.origin`, but the unchanged `ChatController` parses the body and calls `ChatService.ask` without passing `parsed.data.origin` on either the regular or streaming route (see `backend/src/chat/chat.controller.ts` lines 38–48 and 84–94); the service signature also has no origin parameter. Consequently choice, saved-view, and pin requests are currently indistinguishable after validation. MP-ASK-CHOICE is assigned origin-dependent refusal handling, but its listed scope omits `chat.controller.ts`, so that task must add the controller path to its scope and test both routes.
findings.title: Later: MP-ASK-CHOICE must forward `origin` through both chat routes
